title: View details expands each tile to its own detail
custom_preconds:
Signed in as owner/admin (storage state)
A test-created customer has one invoiced Work Order in the current month (seeded via API)
A billable technician has closed clock hours on that work order's labour line
Browser storage holds no `dashboard.expandedTile` key
custom_steps:
1. On each tile, confirm a 'View details' control that expands the tile to reveal its detail (chart, table, or both).
2. Confirm the Revenue tile expands to the Revenue chart; Billing Efficiency to the Billing Efficiency chart and the Advisor Analysis table; Technician Efficiency to its chart and table; Technician Utilization to its chart and table.
3. Confirm the Sales by Customer tile expands to the Sales by Customer table.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each tile shows a "View details" control that expands the tile.
  • Expanding a tile reveals that tile's detail content — its chart, its detail table, or both.
  • The Revenue tile expands to the Revenue chart.
  • The Billing Efficiency tile expands to the Billing Efficiency chart and the Advisor Analysis table.
  • The Technician Efficiency tile expands to the Technician Efficiency chart and the Technician Efficiency table.
  • The Technician Utilization tile expands to the Technician Utilization chart and the Technician Utilization table.
  • The Sales by Customer tile expands to the Sales by Customer table.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9578 (S6 — Expanding a Tile); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S6; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R1: “Each tile shows a "View details" control that expands the tile.”
  • S6-R2: “Expanding a tile reveals that tile's detail content — its chart, its detail table, or both.”
  • S6-R3: “The Revenue tile expands to the Revenue chart.”
  • S6-R4: “The Billing Efficiency tile expands to the Billing Efficiency chart and the Advisor Analysis table.”
  • S6-R5: “The Technician Efficiency tile expands to the Technician Efficiency chart and the Technician Efficiency table.”
  • S6-R6: “The Technician Utilization tile expands to the Technician Utilization chart and the Technician Utilization table.”
  • S6-R7: “The Sales by Customer tile expands to the Sales by Customer table.”
